# Third-Party Asset Sources

All third-party content in this project is licensed under Creative Commons Zero
(CC0 1.0 Universal) and is safe for educational, personal, and commercial use.
License texts are stored in `Assets/ThirdParty/Licenses`.

## ambientCG

Source: https://ambientcg.com/
License: CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)

| Asset | Source page | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Grass004 | https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Grass004 | Island grass |
| Ground037 | https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Ground037 | Dirt and trail |
| Ground054 | https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Ground054 | Beach sand |
| Concrete034 | https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Concrete034 | Bunker concrete |
| Metal032 | https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Metal032 | Doors and machinery |
| MetalPlates006 | https://ambientcg.com/view?id=MetalPlates006 | Industrial panels |
| Wood051 | https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Wood051 | Docks and crates |
| Rock030 | https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Rock030 | Cliffs and boulders |
| Ice003 | https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Ice003 | Water normal placeholder |

Downloaded maps are 1K JPG and include color, OpenGL normal, roughness, and
metalness or ambient occlusion where provided. Textures are unmodified apart
from Unity import settings.
